title: A New Morning Routine
instructions: 这是为A2水平学习者设计的原创模拟听力练习（非官方雅思测试）。先听录音，再完成8道题。听力中有两位说话人：Mia和Ben，他们会自然对话并纠正信息。题目包括单选、填空和判断正误（True/False/Not Given）。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。请先阅读题目，再听录音。
transcript:
Mia: Hi Ben. You look tired today. Are you OK?
Ben: Hi Mia. Yes, I'm fine. But I go to bed very late these days. I sleep only five hours.
Mia: Five hours? That's not good. Why do you sleep so late?
Ben: Because I watch videos on my phone. I start at ten, and I stop at one in the morning.
Mia: Oh no. You should stop at ten. Your phone is bad for your sleep.
Ben: I know. But I like the videos. They are fun.
Mia: Fun, yes, but sleep is more important. You should put your phone in the kitchen.
Ben: In the kitchen? Hmm. Maybe. And I don't exercise now. I'm too busy.
Mia: You should walk every day. Walking is easy and good for you.
Ben: How long? Twenty minutes?
Mia: Thirty minutes is better. It's the best exercise for busy people.
Ben: OK. I can walk to work. It's only fifteen minutes.
Mia: Good. And you should eat breakfast. Do you eat breakfast?
Ben: No, I don't. I only drink coffee.
Mia: Coffee is OK, but breakfast is better. You should eat an egg and some bread.
Ben: An egg and bread. OK. I can do that.
Mia: So, what is your new plan?
Ben: I stop my phone at ten, and I walk to work. I eat breakfast, too.
Mia: That's a good plan. You will feel better.
Ben: I hope so. Thank you, Mia.

grammar.title: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门
grammar.explanation: 1) because 表示原因，so 表示结果。例如：I sleep late because I watch videos. / I watch videos, so I sleep late. 2) should 表示“应该”，后接动词原形，用于给建议。例如：You should walk every day. 3) 比较级用于两者比较，最高级用于三者及以上比较。短形容词一般加 -er / -est；good 的比较级是 better，最高级是 best。例如：Walking is easy. Thirty minutes is better. It's the best exercise.
grammar.example: Thirty minutes is better. It's the best exercise for busy people.

questions.evidence: It's the best exercise for busy people.

questions.explanation: 两者比较，new 的比较级是 newer。
questions.evidence: Your phone is bad for your sleep.

questions.explanation: 三者及以上比较，big 的最高级是 biggest。
questions.evidence: It's the best exercise for busy people.

questions.explanation: 不吃早餐导致十点饿，是结果，用 so。
